title: On the classification of regular graphs with positive Lin-Lu-Yau curvature
summary: We prove several new structural and classification results about $d$-regular graphs with positive Lin--Lu--Yau (LLY) curvature. We show that any positively curved $d$-regular graph has diameter at most $2d-2$, which improves the previously best known diameter bound obtained from the Bonnet-Myers-type theorem for positively curved graphs. We further show that every positively curved $d$-regular graph with $d\ge 3$ is $3$-connected. We classify all positively curved $3$-regular graphs, as well as all positively curved regular planar graphs.
